name: Negative - Not Allowed to Check for Team
goal: User without manager access tries to reference another employee or Ecode. Bot denies and does not proceed.
constraints: isManagerAllowed is 'no'. User mentions another employee or Ecode in free text. Bot must block and not proceed to year selection.

testdata.user_message: I want to see appraisal letter for Ecode EMP9999

phases.description: Run setup workflow and confirm user is not a manager.
User mentions another employee in their message.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot replies 'You are not allowed to see someone else's appraisal letter.' and does not proceed.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
